description: External, out-of-distribution bughunt suite: real fix commits in third-party Rust crates. No third-party source is stored here; benchmark/fetch_external.py clones the pinned commits and builds the gold sets locally.

cases.name: ext-http-a8309a9
cases.summary: Authority::from_static accepted a valid authority prefix followed by unparsed bytes (a scheme, path or query)

cases.name: ext-http-3dd9f5e
cases.summary: OccupiedEntry::insert_mult panicked when the entry already held three or more values

cases.name: ext-http-c6af28b
cases.summary: HeaderName::from_lowercase accepted a double quote, which the tchar grammar forbids in field names

cases.name: ext-http-e559023
cases.summary: PathAndQuery parsing skipped the URI length limit that the rest of the URI parser enforces

cases.name: ext-http-6e2dd42
cases.summary: HeaderMap::extend trusted an iterator's size_hint, so an over-estimate overflowed reserve and panicked

cases.name: ext-http-a9cdbf8
cases.summary: PathAndQuery accepted the DEL control character (0x7F) in the path and the query

cases.name: ext-rust-url-e219288
cases.summary: Each `..` segment at the root searched back through the scheme and authority, making parsing quadratic

cases.name: ext-rust-url-13b385b
cases.summary: form_urlencoded::Serializer::for_suffix panicked when the start position was past the end of the target

cases.name: ext-rust-url-25137be
cases.summary: The path percent-encode set left `^` unencoded, so it reached the serialized URL raw

cases.name: ext-rust-url-e654efb
cases.summary: Decoding a non-base64 data: URL repeated bytes after a `%` that was not followed by two hex digits

cases.name: ext-httparse-7ab0192
cases.summary: With spaces allowed after header names, one invalid character between the name and the colon was accepted

cases.name: ext-httparse-c0631f2
cases.summary: A response with no reason phrase and LF-only line endings folded the status line into the first header name (`200\nfoo`)

cases.name: ext-httparse-5654959
cases.summary: The token and URI parsers accepted empty results, so a request line with an empty method or path parsed

cases.name: ext-semver-5742fc2
cases.summary: The requirement <I.J matched I.J.0 prereleases, which it must exclude
